parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the benchmark as a clean-room reimplementation of seqtk behavior, constrained to bundled docs and normal CLI interaction with the original executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It used a parent orchestrator plus docs, CLI, RNG, minor-command, sample, telo, and merge/fqchk child probes, with the parent retaining implementation and patch ownership in the shared workspace.
parallel.implementation: It built a Rust replacement covering many seqtk subcommands and kept probing mismatches, but non-default sample output remained inconsistent with the oracle late in the run.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent worked in the final shared workspace and preserved the oracle for comparison, but the run ended before a fully integrated and verified final behavior set was closed.
parallel.verification: The run performed many side-by-side oracle comparisons and discovered concrete sample mismatches, but late fan-out and waits left no comparable final all-OK fixture sweep before termination.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: At closure the parallel process had return code 143, 278 of 440 official tests passed, and visible sample RNG/order mismatches remained unresolved.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same clean-room task, no-source/no-wrapper restrictions, and executable-only behavioral observation requirement.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept all documentation reading, black-box probing, implementation, integration, cleanup, and delivery under one agent with multi-agent disabled and zero spawned children.
serial.implementation: It implemented a Python replacement and iteratively fixed observed command behavior, including late comp CpG-linked counts and mutfa header-comment handling.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial agent kept one final implementation path with a compile entrypoint and reported a clean-room replacement plus retained black-box fixtures.
serial.verification: It ran a broad fixture suite that returned OK across top-level CLI and many subcommands with failed 0 before final response, then the official evaluator scored 313 of 440.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: It still failed official evaluation and acknowledged residual risk in non-default sample seeds, some randbase paths, and fqchk errQ calculation, but it exited normally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Multiple agents shared the workspace, but the reviewed evidence does not prove a destructive file collision, overwrite, or contamination event.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control worked in a single implementation workspace and protocol validation recorded no delegation or contamination findings.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Shared-state risk was higher in parallel, but the retained difference is not a write-race label because the concrete adverse process evidence is budget exhaustion.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed, but serial had stronger pre-closure acceptance evidence and higher official coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel process ran 2399.4 seconds, returned code 143, used 11 spawns and 9 child threads, and made a late fan-out at 09:15.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial process ran 1738.475 seconds, returned code 0, used zero spawn calls, and delivered a final response with residual risks documented.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel exhausted its closure window under late breadth, while serial finished normally despite remaining implementation gaps.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluations show both runs failed: parallel passed 278/440 and serial passed 313/440. The difference is therefore material coverage and closure, not a discordant official pass/fail outcome. Parallel spread late remaining work across sample, telo, and mergefa/fqchk probes while sample mismatches were still visible and the process ended by signal. Serial used one continuous trajectory, fixed concrete late mismatches, verified a broad all-OK fixture suite, exited normally, and left fewer official failures.
parallel_contributors: Late broad fan-out after extensive earlier delegation consumed the closure window.
Non-default sample behavior remained visibly wrong in oracle comparisons moments before termination.
The process ended with return code 143 after 2399.4 seconds and lower official coverage.
serial_contributors: Single-owner execution kept probing, implementation, and verification state together.
The agent fixed observed comp and mutfa mismatches late in the run.
A broad local fixture suite reported failed 0 before final response and official coverage was higher.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel's sample RNG/order behavior remained wrong for non-default seeds.
Serial still had ordinary residual implementation gaps in less-constrained sample, randbase, and fqchk behavior, so it also failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: both failed; the retained pattern is a parallel adverse contributor to lower coverage, not an outcome-differential root cause
